headline: Reuters reports heightened risks to commercial shipping around the Strait of Hormuz
india_implication: Analyst assessment: disruption near Hormuz could raise insurance and freight costs and increase uncertainty for India's energy imports. Monitor official maritime advisories, oil prices and shipping updates.

headline: Reuters reports record-high freight costs for Russian Urals oil shipments to India in early October
india_implication: Analyst assessment: higher freight costs may reduce the price advantage of Russian crude and complicate refinery economics. Compare freight costs with crude discounts, insurance and alternative supply costs before drawing conclusions.

headline: Reuters reports delays and possible cancellations affecting India-bound sunflower oil cargoes amid Black Sea disruption
india_implication: Analyst assessment: shipping disruption may delay edible-oil arrivals and push some buyers toward substitutes. Check actual cargo arrivals, domestic prices and alternative-origin import data before estimating the impact.
